aboutOrion.title: What is Orion One?
aboutOrion.origin: Built on the foundation of Projeto Yara — a robotic neurosurgery assistance system currently in regulatory review — Orion One applies over 6 years of surgical research to precision medicine.
aboutOrion.p1: Orion One is a state-of-the-art surgical neuronavigation system developed for precision medicine. It acts as a "GPS for the surgeon," allowing them to visualize the exact position of instruments in real-time on the patient's CT or MRI scans.
aboutOrion.p2: This technology transforms complex procedures into safer, faster, and minimally invasive surgeries, dramatically raising the standard of care and improving outcomes for neurosurgeries and precision orthopedics.

zenith.tagline: Record, photograph and review every procedure — everything saved to the cloud automatically and organized by patient.
zenith.description: Zenith attaches to the surgical microscope you already own and turns every procedure into a clinical record. 12 MP sensor, cable-free connection to any device on the same network, and automatic upload to Guide. On Lite, a touchscreen gallery for in-room review. On Pro, stereoscopic 3D in the glasses — and the microscope starts working as an exoscope.

pillar1.title: 12 MP Sensor, High-Resolution Capture
pillar1.p: Record video and capture photos at 12 MP straight from the microscope. On Lite, everything shows up instantly on the touchscreen. On Pro, follow along on the stream from any screen in the clinic.

pillar2.title: No Cables, On Your Network
pillar2.p: Connect laptops, tablets and displays from anywhere in the clinic over Wi-Fi. No new cabling, no construction work in the operating room.

pillar3.title: Cloud Organized by Patient
pillar3.p: Every image and video uploads automatically to Guide, filed in the patient's record and reachable from wherever you are.

card1.title: Image Fusion
card1.p: Combine images from different modalities (CT, MRI) into a single view, providing a more complete and accurate picture of the patient's anatomy.

card2.title: Real-Time Tracking
card2.p: Track the exact position of your surgical instruments on the 3D model and in 2D views, ensuring precise and safe approaches.

card3.title: Advanced Planning
card3.p: Plan complex surgical approaches with millimeter precision, using intelligent segmentations that optimize the surgical outcome.

card4.title: Intuitive & Compatible Interface
card4.p: Developed with the surgeon in mind, Orion One features a clean interface and is compatible with major CT and MRI scanners on the market, facilitating seamless integration into your workflow.

card5.title: Customizable Instruments
card5.p: Easily register and calibrate your own surgical instruments, offering full flexibility to adapt to your techniques and preferences.

card6.title: Dedicated Support and Training
card6.p: Rely on our team of specialists for comprehensive training and ongoing support, ensuring you get the most out of Orion One.

card1.title: CT Scan Definition
card1.p: Import and process high-resolution CT scan images to obtain a detailed 3D model of the patient's spine for planning each step of the surgery.

card2.title: Real-Time Tracking
card2.p: Track the exact position of surgical instruments relative to the vertebrae in real time, ensuring precise and minimally invasive approaches.

card3.title: Advanced Planning with Screw Planning
card3.p: Virtually plan the trajectory and positioning of each pedicle screw before surgery, reducing risks and optimizing clinical outcomes.

card4.title: Personalized Instruments
card4.p: Calibrate and use your own instruments and implants, adapting the system to your technical preferences and your surgical team's protocols.

card5.title: Dedicated Support
card5.p: Our team of specialists provides comprehensive training and continuous support, ensuring you get the most out of the Orion One Spine module.

step1.title: Import the Image
step1.p: Load the patient's CT or MRI scans into the system with just a few clicks.
step1.detailed_p: Import the exam easily: just drag the file onto the screen, and all views, including the patient's 3D model, will be loaded instantly.

step2.title: Plan the Surgery
step2.p: Use the 3D model to define trajectories, mark targets, and simulate the procedure before the first incision.
step2.detailed_p: The Guide platform offers exclusive planning tools. Perform measurements, set angles, draw contours, and segment structures with high precision to optimize and streamline the surgical procedure.

step3.title: Perform Registration
step3.p: Correlate the patient's anatomy on the surgical table with the 3D model, ensuring the system's accuracy.
step3.detailed_p: Registration for neurosurgery is a two-step process: first, capture 3 fiducial points on both the patient and the scan. Then, a surface registration with 10 random points in the area of interest refines the system's accuracy.

step4.title: Start Navigating
step4.p: Perform the surgery with the confidence of seeing the exact position of your instruments in real-time.
step4.detailed_p: Navigate in real-time with 6 simultaneous views (3D, Parallel, Orthogonal, Axial, Coronal, and Sagittal) for superior spatial awareness. Use real-time segmentation to easily identify anatomical structures of interest.

step1.title: Import the CT Scan
step1.p: Load the patient's spinal CT scan and obtain a complete 3D model of the vertebrae.
step1.detailed_p: Import the exam easily: drag the file onto the screen and all vertebral views, including the 3D model, will be loaded instantly for planning.

step2.title: Plan the Screws
step2.p: Virtually define the pedicle screw trajectories with precise angulation and depth.
step2.detailed_p: Use the Orion Spine planning tools to virtually position each screw, check safety distances, and optimize the surgical strategy before the first incision.

step3.title: Perform Registration
step3.p: Correlate the spinal anatomy on the surgical table with the 3D model, ensuring millimetric accuracy.
step3.detailed_p: Registration for spinal surgery correlates anatomical landmarks of the vertebrae with the 3D model quickly and accurately, ensuring millimetric navigation throughout the entire procedure.

step4.title: Navigate Safely
step4.p: Perform screw insertion with the confidence of seeing the exact position of your instruments in real time.
step4.detailed_p: Navigate in real time following the planned trajectories, with simultaneous multi-view visualization to confirm the perfect positioning of each vertebral implant.

shared.title: What changes in your operating room
shared.sub: Features present in both tiers — Zenith's capture and connectivity foundation.

f1.title: Every case documented effortlessly
f1.p: On Lite, start recording with one tap. On Pro, trigger via mouse or the stream viewer on another device. What used to live only in memory becomes a clinical archive — useful for tracking progress, discussing with colleagues and backing up your decisions.

f2.title: Review the procedure while still in the room
f2.p: On Lite, the touchscreen holds the full gallery for the case — check the framing, show a detail to the resident and confirm the record before closing, with no second computer involved. On Pro, review through the stream viewer on any screen in the clinic.

f3.title: No cables, on any screen in the clinic
f3.p: Zenith talks over Wi-Fi to any device on the same network. Mirror it to a monitor in the room, send it to the laptop for case discussion or follow along on a tablet — no cable running across the sterile field.

f4.title: Everything in Guide, filed by patient
f4.p: By the end, images and video are already in the patient's record inside Guide, reachable from home, from another branch or from a conference. No flash drives, no folder lost on a desktop.

proOnly.title: Surgery outside the eyepiece
proOnly.sub: What the Pro tier adds on top of everything Lite already does.

f1.title: Real depth, straight to the glasses
f1.p: The stereoscopic image is streamed to the glasses and reproduces the depth of field you already know from the eyepiece — no digital trickery. Your microscope starts working as an exoscope, without being replaced.

f2.title: Your spine will thank you on long cases
f2.p: With no eyepiece dictating your body position, you operate with your head up and shift posture whenever you need to. On procedures that run for hours, that is the difference between finishing intact and finishing with neck pain.

guide.title: Guide: one place for every patient
guide.tagline: Images, video, medical records and surgical planning at the same address — reachable from wherever you are.
guide.description: Guide is BMT's cloud platform. Everything Zenith captures and everything you plan in Orion One arrives organized by patient, alongside the clinical history. Instead of images scattered across flash drives, phones and clinic computers, every case has a single address — and it opens in any browser.

pillar1.title: One Record per Patient
pillar1.p: Video, photos, exams and notes in the same clinical case. Find a procedure from months ago in seconds, without hunting for a file.

pillar2.title: Image-Based Planning
pillar2.p: Measure, set angles, draw contours and segment structures before you walk into the room — the same tools used in the Orion One workflow.

pillar3.title: Access from Anywhere
pillar3.p: It runs in the browser. Review a case from home, show progress to the owner during a follow-up, or discuss it with a colleague in another city.

f1.title: The end of scattered images
f1.p: Every video and photo arrives already linked to the right patient, with date and procedure. No more flash drive in a drawer, unnamed folder on a desktop, or the important video stuck on someone's phone.

f2.title: Clinical history next to the imaging
f2.p: History, progress notes and treatment sit right beside the procedure material. When it is time to decide the next step, you look at the whole case at once — not pieces of it.

f3.title: Tools to plan before you operate
f3.p: Take measurements, set angles, draw contours and segment structures with high precision. The same toolset surgeons use in the Orion One workflow, available for any case.

f4.title: The whole clinic in the browser
f4.p: Nothing to install, no dependence on the computer in the room. Open the case from home the night before, show it to the owner at the follow-up, or review it on a tablet between surgeries.

f5.title: An archive ready to teach and present
f5.p: Well-documented cases become teaching material, team discussion and conference presentations. What you already record in your routine starts paying off outside the operating room.

demoOrion.accessSub: Each model was designed for a different clinic profile. During the demo, we present the investment details for each option.

access1.title: Annual Lease
access1.p: Pay per surgery performed with the system, with a guaranteed minimum monthly fee. Ideal for clinics that want to incorporate the technology without a high initial investment — and charge for a differentiated service from day one.

access2.title: Direct Purchase
access2.p: Acquire the system with full ownership. No recurring contract dependency, no fee per surgery. The choice of surgical centers with high procedure volume that want to maximize return on investment.

demoOrion.accessCtaNote: Investment values for each model are presented during the demo — schedule below and find out which fits best with your clinic.

faq1.q: Does Orion One work with my CT scanner?
faq1.a: Yes. Orion One imports images in DICOM format, the universal standard for all CT scanners and MRI machines on the market. No special integration or equipment replacement is needed.

faq2.a: Orion One was designed to have a short learning curve. We provide comprehensive training for all clients and ongoing support from the BMT team. Most surgeons operate independently after the first in-person training.

faq3.a: Orion One is currently available for neurosurgery (Orion Brain) and spinal surgery (Orion Spine). The module for hip surgeries (Orion Hip) is in development and will be launched soon.

faq4.q: Does the demo have any cost?
faq4.a: None. The demo is completely free and no-commitment. You'll see the system live and talk directly with a BMT specialist — no sales pressure.

faq1.q: Does Zenith work with my microscope?
faq1.a: Zenith was designed for universal compatibility with the main surgical microscopes on the market, and that holds for both tiers. In the demo we verify exact compatibility with your model — if there is any exception, you find out before any decision.

faq2.q: What is the difference between Lite and Pro?
faq2.a: The capture foundation is identical: both record video and capture photos at 12 MP, connect cable-free to the clinic network and send everything to the Guide cloud organized by patient. Lite adds a touchscreen gallery — case review in the room, no second computer needed. Pro replaces the screen with stereoscopic 3D in the glasses and recording control via mouse or stream viewer: the microscope starts working as an exoscope.

faq3.q: Do I need to replace my current microscope?
faq3.a: No. Zenith integrates with your existing microscope, on both tiers. No replacement needed and no major work in the operating suite — and since the connection is over Wi-Fi, there is no new cabling to run either.

faq4.q: Where are the videos and photos stored?
faq4.a: In Guide, BMT's cloud platform. Every recording uploads automatically and is filed in the matching patient's record, alongside the clinical history, reachable from any browser anywhere. No flash drives or loose folders on the computer in the room.

accessLite.title: Zenith Lite
accessLite.p: Recording, photos, touchscreen gallery, cable-free connection to the clinic network and automatic upload to the Guide cloud, organized by patient. For those who want to document their entire caseload without changing how they operate.

accessPro.title: Zenith Pro
accessPro.p: 12 MP capture, Wi-Fi and Guide cloud — plus stereoscopic 3D in the glasses and recording control via mouse or stream viewer. The microscope starts working as an exoscope, no built-in screen. For long procedures and anyone who wants out of the eyepiece without giving up depth of field.

faq5.a: None. The demo is completely free and with no strings attached. You will see Zenith live and talk directly to a BMT specialist — with no sales pressure.
